initiatives.name: Microsoft Cloud Strategic Partnership and Infrastructure
initiatives.summary: LSEG entered a 10-year strategic partnership with Microsoft to architect its data infrastructure using Microsoft Cloud and jointly develop new data and analytics products. The partnership includes a minimum cloud-related spend commitment and underpins Workspace, AI and Digital Markets Infrastructure initiatives.

evidence.title: Network re-platforming and software-defined networks
evidence.summary: LSEG re-platformed its trade routing network in Microsoft Azure, connecting 1,600 brokers and asset managers via the cloud, and made substantial progress migrating to software-defined networks, reducing device obsolescence by 80% while tripling capacity.
evidence.quote: We re-platformed our trade routing network in Microsoft Azure, connecting 1,600 brokers and asset managers via the cloud. We also made substantial progress in migrating to software-defined networks, reducing device obsolescence by 80% while tripling capacity.

evidence.title: Cash capex of £919 million supporting growth programmes
evidence.summary: LSEG invested £919 million in cash capital expenditure in 2025, down from £957 million in 2024, reflecting disciplined investment and declining capital intensity while funding Workspace, Microsoft partnership products, and new platforms across Markets, FTSE Russell and Risk Intelligence.
evidence.quote: Cash capex in the year of £919 million reflected ongoing investment in key growth programmes. We have accelerated product innovation in our Workspace platform, investing in new, powerful capabilities in partnership with Microsoft.

evidence.title: Launch of Digital Markets Infrastructure (DMI) platform
evidence.summary: LSEG launched a blockchain-powered Digital Markets Infrastructure platform built on Microsoft Azure, delivering efficiencies across the full asset lifecycle of trades from issuance to post-trade settlement. The first use case in private markets has completed its first transaction, with fixed income (gilt tokenisation) as the next use case.
evidence.quote: We launched our Digital Markets Infrastructure (DMI) platform in September, marking a major step in our ambition to be the first global exchange group helping customers across the full funding continuum.

evidence.title: 10-year strategic cloud partnership with Microsoft
evidence.summary: LSEG entered a 10-year strategic partnership with Microsoft to architect its data infrastructure using Microsoft Cloud and jointly develop new data and analytics products. The partnership includes a minimum cloud-related spend commitment and underpins Workspace, AI and Digital Markets Infrastructure initiatives.
evidence.quote: 10-year strategic partnership with Microsoft To architect LSEG’s data infrastructure using the Microsoft Cloud, and to jointly develop new products and services for data and analytics Minimum cloud-related spend of US$2.8 billion over the term of the partnership

initiatives.name: Science-Based Emissions Reduction Targets
initiatives.summary: LSEG reduced Scope 1 and 2 (market-based) emissions by 15% year-on-year and 86% versus 2019 baseline, and Scope 3 emissions by 26% year-on-year, achieving a 66% overall reduction from 2019 baseline, driven largely by reduced business travel.

evidence.title: Progress on science-based emissions targets
evidence.summary: LSEG reduced Scope 1 and 2 (market-based) emissions by 15% year-on-year and 86% versus 2019 baseline, and Scope 3 emissions by 26% year-on-year, achieving a 66% overall reduction from 2019 baseline, driven largely by reduced business travel.
evidence.quote: We saw a 15% reduction against prior year against our target for Scope 1 and Scope 2 (market based) emissions and an 86% reduction against our 2019 baseline... by the end of 2025, we had reduced our carbon emissions addressed by our climate transition plan by 66% from a 2019 baseline.

evidence.title: Supplier science-based target engagement
evidence.summary: LSEG is working with suppliers to set science-based emissions targets, with 56% of emissions from purchased goods and services now covered by suppliers who have set or committed to targets, against a goal of 67% by end of 2026.
evidence.quote: In 2025, suppliers responsible for 56% of our emissions from purchased goods and services have either already set or have committed to setting science-based targets. This is against our target to achieve 67% by the end of 2026.

initiatives.name: LSEG Everywhere AI Strategy
initiatives.summary: LSEG launched its LSEG Everywhere AI strategy built on three pillars (Trusted Data, Transformative Products, Intelligent Enterprise), including Model Context Protocol (MCP) infrastructure enabling AI-ready data access via partnerships with Anthropic, OpenAI, Databricks, Snowflake and Microsoft Copilot Studio.

evidence.title: LSEG Everywhere AI strategy with MCP infrastructure
evidence.summary: LSEG launched its LSEG Everywhere AI strategy built on three pillars (Trusted Data, Transformative Products, Intelligent Enterprise), including Model Context Protocol (MCP) infrastructure enabling AI-ready data access via partnerships with Anthropic, OpenAI, Databricks, Snowflake and Microsoft Copilot Studio.
evidence.quote: The introduction of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) is creating a new era of data-driven innovation. It gives us the ability to have LSEG AI-ready data safely presented alongside large language models (LLMs) and we have announced partnerships with Anthropic, Databricks, OpenAI, Snowflake and others.

evidence.title: AI-powered Question and Answer Service (QAS) deployment
evidence.summary: LSEG's AI-powered Question and Answer Service is now used in over 80% of customer cases, enabling half of customer queries to be resolved within an hour, demonstrating embedding of AI into customer service processes.
evidence.quote: our AI-powered Question and Answer Service (QAS) is now being used in over 80% of all customer cases, enabling half of customer queries to be resolved within an hour.

initiatives.name: Post Trade Solutions Investor Partnership
initiatives.summary: LSEG completed a partnership and investment transaction in its Post Trade Solutions business, with 11 leading global banks taking a 20% stake, enhancing strategic alignment with key customers and replicating the LCH model. The transaction generated £170 million in proceeds and a c.100bps EBITDA margin benefit.

evidence.title: Post Trade Solutions: 11 banks take 20% stake

The transaction generated £170 million in proceeds and a c.100bps EBITDA margin benefit.
evidence.quote: We completed a significant partnership and investment in our Post Trade Solutions business with 11 leading banks taking a 20% stake.

initiatives.name: SwapClear Revenue Surplus Investment
initiatives.summary: LSEG deployed £921 million to acquire an increased proportion of the SwapClear revenue surplus and extended the revenue-sharing agreement with partner banks by 10 years, increasing LSEG's share of economics, with a further £250 million payment due in 2026.

evidence.title: SwapClear revenue surplus purchase and extended partnership
evidence.summary: LSEG deployed £921 million to acquire an increased proportion of the SwapClear revenue surplus and extended the revenue-sharing agreement with partner banks by 10 years, increasing LSEG's share of economics, with a further £250 million payment due in 2026.
evidence.quote: The Group deployed £921 million on the purchase of an increased proportion of the revenue surplus from the SwapClear business. A further payment of £250 million will be made in 2026.

initiatives.name: Eikon to Workspace Migration
initiatives.summary: LSEG retired its legacy Eikon platform and migrated approximately 350,000 users to its next-generation workflow tool, LSEG Workspace, described as one of the largest financial services workflow migrations in history.

evidence.title: Eikon to Workspace migration completed
evidence.summary: LSEG retired its legacy Eikon platform and migrated approximately 350,000 users to its next-generation workflow tool, LSEG Workspace, described as one of the largest financial services workflow migrations in history.
evidence.quote: We completed the migration of around 350,000 users to our next-generation workflow tool, LSEG Workspace, sunsetting the legacy platform in the process.

initiatives.name: Engineering Workforce In-sourcing
initiatives.summary: LSEG is shifting its engineering workforce from external contractors to internal employees, reducing external headcount from c.11,000 to c.9,200 group-wide, with engineering now 60% internal (up from 49%), targeting 80% internal mix.

evidence.title: Engineering workforce in-sourcing programme
evidence.summary: LSEG is shifting its engineering workforce from external contractors to internal employees, reducing external headcount from c.11,000 to c.9,200 group-wide, with engineering now 60% internal (up from 49%), targeting 80% internal mix.
evidence.quote: We continue to optimise staff costs, including through our engineering workforce in-sourcing programme: 60% of our engineers are now internal, compared to 49% in 2024... driven by a reduction in external contractors from c. 11,000 to c. 9,200.

initiatives.name: Private Securities Market Launch (PISCES)
initiatives.summary: LSEG launched the London Stock Exchange's Private Securities Market, becoming the first operator to receive a PISCES Approval Notice from the FCA, establishing a regulated venue for private company liquidity auctions, expanding into new market segments.

evidence.title: Launch of Private Securities Market and PISCES approval
evidence.summary: LSEG launched the London Stock Exchange's Private Securities Market, becoming the first operator to receive a PISCES Approval Notice from the FCA, establishing a regulated venue for private company liquidity auctions, expanding into new market segments.
evidence.quote: As the first operator to receive a PISCES Approval Notice from the FCA, we are establishing a regulated venue where private companies can access intermittent liquidity auctions for the first time, supported by the same resilient infrastructure that underpins our public markets.
